command:
cd /tmp/ch1-ref/os && cat > /tmp/ch1-ref/trace.gdb <<'EOF'
set pagination off
set confirm off
set logging file /tmp/ch1-ref/reports/ch1-gdb.log
set logging overwrite on
set logging enabled on
set architecture riscv:rv64
set language c
target remote localhost:1234

printf "\n########## 1. entry: _start ##########\n"
tbreak _start
continue
info registers pc sp
x/4i $pc
p/x (unsigned long)&boot_stack_lower_bound
p/x (unsigned long)&boot_stack_top
p/d (char *)&boot_stack_top - (char *)&boot_stack_lower_bound

printf "\n########## 2. rust_main ##########\n"
tbreak rust_main
continue
bt
info registers pc sp

printf "\n########## 3. clear_bss ##########\n"
tbreak os::clear_bss
continue
bt
set $bss_begin = (unsigned long)&sbss
set $bss_end = (unsigned long)&ebss
p/x $bss_begin
p/x $bss_end
p/d $bss_end - $bss_begin
x/16bx $bss_begin

printf "\n########## 4. clear_bss closure and sb write ##########\n"
tbreak *0x802029c0
continue
info args
bt
x/10i $pc
tbreak *0x802029fa
continue
info registers pc a0 a1
x/i $pc
si
x/8bx $bss_begin

printf "\n########## 5. logging::init ##########\n"
tbreak os::logging::init
continue
bt
x/16bx $bss_begin

printf "\n########## 6. console::print ##########\n"
tbreak os::console::print
continue
bt
x/10i $pc

printf "\n########## 7. console_putchar and ecall ##########\n"
tbreak os::sbi::console_putchar
continue
info args
p/x c
bt
disassemble /r 0x80201d8c,0x80201dc0
tbreak *0x80201db0
continue
x/i $pc
info registers a0 a1 a2 a6 a7

printf "\n########## 8. exit_success -> exit -> MMIO sw ##########\n"
tbreak *0x802026d8
continue
bt
step
info args
p/x code
p/x self->addr
disassemble /r 0x80202658,0x802026d8
tbreak *0x802026ce
continue
info registers pc a0 a1
x/i $pc
si
printf "\n########## done ##########\n"
set logging enabled off
quit
EOF
rm -f reports/ch1-gdb.log qemu.log
qemu-system-riscv64 -machine virt -nographic -bios ../bootloader/rustsbi-qemu.bin -device loader,file=target/riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf/debug/os.bin,addr=0x80200000 -s -S > qemu.log 2>&1 &
QPID=$!
sleep 1
timeout 90 gdb -nx -q -batch -x /tmp/ch1-ref/trace.gdb target/riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf/debug/os 2>&1 | tail -25
echo "=== qemu still alive? ==="
if kill -0 $QPID 2>/dev/null; then echo "yes (pid $QPID), killing"; kill $QPID 2>/dev/null; else echo "no (QEMU exited)"; fi
echo "=== gdb log lines: $(wc -l < reports/ch1-gdb.log 2>/dev/null) ==="
